value.rationale: A full two-dimensional natural moduli family of equal-exponent five-branch cyclic covers has identical p-rank and a-number, yet Cartier squared isolates one geometrically canonical Hermitian branch locus; all other curves have rank-one square. The iff characterization identifies a non-arbitrary special stratum and connects it with a genus-six maximal curve without claiming previously known Hermitian results as new.
